name: biological-modular-seam
title: Biological seam: modular submodels
question: If the model is partitioned along a biological seam (upper vs lower glycolysis at aldolase/F16P) into two coupled process nodes sharing a store, does it still reproduce the reference, and is this a genuine multi-process composition?
hypothesis: A biological upper/lower partition, reconciled additively through the real process-bigraph apply path, reproduces the reference within tolerance and is genuinely composable (two independent process nodes, not one process with an internal loop).
objective: Decompose the model along a biological seam into coupled process nodes and verify genuine composability.
description: Study in the SBML-decomposition investigation on Teusink glycolysis (BIOMD0000000064, 17 floating species). The model is authored as inline Antimony and shown in the Model tab. Two SubmodelProcess nodes (upper/lower glycolysis) + an EnergyStep share ONE species store and reconcile additive deltas through the real bigraph apply/reconcile path. Realised by the generic reaction_split composite (seam=aldolase, tellurium + tellurium).
claim: A biological-seam decomposition reproduces the reference (0.468 → 0.100 as the coupling step shrinks, T=0.15) as a GENUINE multi-process composition — the first point on the spectrum where the model is composable.

expected_behavior.name: biological-seam-matches-reference
expected_behavior.observable: max relative error vs monolithic reference
expected_behavior.condition: status ok and max_rel_err within T=0.15, with error shrinking as the coupling step shrinks
expected_behavior.rationale: a biological decomposition must stay faithful while being genuinely composable.

findings.summary: Two process nodes share one species store, reconciling additively through the bigraph apply path (verified: core.apply/reconcile sum the deltas, not a local loop). Reproduces the mechanical-split reference exactly.
coupling step 0.002 → max_rel_err 0.468; 0.0005 → 0.100 (T=0.15). Looser than mechanical-split-cost because this seam crosses the strong energy coupling; divergence is guarded to status=diverged.
overhead_fraction ~0.05 (far below the monolith's 0.32): the decomposed composite spends more wall-clock inside the processes, so the framework is a smaller share.
